title: 第25章 神秘病情第26章 阵发性震颤性肌群爆发综合症
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 行政楼，副院长办公室内。
赵副院长坐在办公桌后，手指一下一下地敲着桌面，平日里他一向沉稳，今天却难得显得有些焦急。
作为江城市第一人民医院的副院长，他在江城医疗系统内也算是手眼通天的人物了，什么风声都瞒不过他。
今早七点多，他刚到办公室，就已经知道了一个消息。
二院的人，去接触苏业了。
不止二院。
还有市妇保、附属中医院，甚至连省城那边都有人打电话来打听情况。
这让赵副院长心里顿时绷紧了。
苏业。
执医证笔试省一。
这个名头一出来，含金量太重了，这是他们一院的宝贝啊。
整个江南省，每年学医的年轻人有多少？本科生、硕士、规培生、住院医师，统统扔进去一起考，苏业一个人站在了最顶点，这就是一顶一的超级天才啊。
这种人，只要后面自己不犯大错，规培顺利结束，临床路子走稳了，那就是正儿八经的人才种子。
人才这种东西，本来就是抢出来的。
现在他们近水楼台，反而怕极了被其他人抢走。
赵副院长又想起了今天早上那几个电话。
省里的医疗界大人物，平日里很少会主动过问一个小小规培生的事情，结果今天一早，一个接一个，旁敲侧击地问苏业的情况，问他现在在一院的表现如何，问他未来有没有别的安排。
这让赵副院长更害怕了。
这是惦记上了。
他正想着，门外忽然传来敲门声。
咚咚。
赵副院长收回思绪，声音平稳了下来。
“请进。”
门被推开。
苏业走了进来。
年轻，干净，眼神明亮，身上有一种不属于普通规培生的沉静气质，赵副院长打量了他两眼，心里又轻轻感慨了一句。
难怪，单是这份精气神，就不一般。
“坐吧。”
“谢谢院长。”
苏业坐下，神色平静。
赵副院长开门见山，半句废话都没说。
“苏业，你这次执医证考试，省一，做得很好。”
“谢谢院长，运气而已。”
“你也别太谦虚。”赵副院长摆了摆手，“省一不是靠运气能拿到的，这种成绩放在整个江南省，都足以让很多人疯狂。”
苏业明白副院长是在点今早的二院的事。
“不奇怪。”赵副院长靠在椅背上，语气平淡，但眼神很认真，“你这样的年轻人，本来就是要被抢的，可你既然现在在一院规培，那我们也不会眼睁睁看着自己的人才被别人挖走。”
说到这里，他从抽屉里拿出一份文件，推到了苏业面前。
“这是医院给你的留院意向协议。”
苏业低头看了一眼。
白纸黑字，抬头明确写着《江城市第一人民医院青年人才留院意向协议书》。
赵副院长继续说道：“意思很简单，你先签下来，规培结束之后，只要没有重大差错，没有原则性问题，医院肯定会优先录用你，人事那边、科室那边，我都会提前帮你打好招呼。”
“另外，技能评分、轮转考核，只要你继续保持现在的表现，我们这边都会往高了给，至于规培时间……”赵副院长顿了一下，嘴角露出一点意味深长的笑意，“会酌情减少一部分。”
苏业抬起头。
规培时间这种东西，原则上是定死的，轻易动不了，但赵副院长既然敢说出来，就说明医院这边已经准备给他开绿灯了。
赵副院长看着苏业，语气很淡，却很实在。
content_en:
Administrative Building, in the Office of the Vice President.
Vice President Zhao was sitting behind his desk, tapping his fingers on the table. He was usually calm, but today he seemed a little anxious.
As the vice president of Jiangcheng City's First People's Hospital, he is considered a well-versed figure in Jiangcheng's medical system. No news can be hidden from him.
As soon as he arrived at the office at around seven o'clock this morning, he already knew the news.
People from the Second Academy went to contact Su Ye.
Not just the second house.
There are also people from the Municipal Maternity Insurance Company, the Affiliated Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, and even the provincial capital calling to inquire about the situation.
This made Vice President Zhao feel tense immediately.
Su Ye.
The written examination for medical license will be exempted by one.
As soon as this name came out, it contained too much gold. It was the treasure of their hospital.
In the entire Jiangnan Province, how many young people study medicine every year? Undergraduate students, master's students, graduate students, and residents were all thrown in to take the exam together. Su Ye stood at the top alone. This was a super genius.
This kind of person, as long as he does not make big mistakes later, the regular training is successfully completed, and the clinical path is stable, then he is a serious talent seed.
Talent is something that is always snatched away.
Now that they are close to the water, they are extremely afraid of being snatched away by others.
Vice President Zhao thought of those phone calls again this morning.
Big figures in the medical field in the province rarely take the initiative to ask about the affairs of a small-time student. As a result, early this morning, one after another, they asked insinuatingly about Su ye's situation, how he was doing in the first hospital, and whether he had any other plans for the future.
This made Vice President Zhao even more scared.
This is thinking about it.
Just as he was thinking about it, there was a sudden knock on the door.
Boom boom.
Vice President Zhao recovered his thoughts and his voice became calmer.
"Please come in."
The door was pushed open.
Su ye walked in.
Young, clean, with bright eyes, he had a calm temperament that did not belong to ordinary graduate students. Vice President Zhao looked at him and sighed softly in his heart.
No wonder, this spirit alone is extraordinary.
"Sit down."
"Thank you, Dean."
Su ye sat down and looked calm.
Vice President Zhao got straight to the point and didn't say any nonsense.
"Su Ye, you saved one in this medical license exam and did a great job."
"Thank you Dean, it's just luck."
"Don't be too modest." Vice President Zhao waved his hand, "You can't get the first place in the province by luck. This kind of result in the entire Jiangnan Province is enough to make many people crazy."
Su ye understood that the vice president was talking about the matters in the Second House this morning.
"It's not surprising." Vice President Zhao leaned back in his chair, his tone was calm, but his eyes were serious, "Young people like you are meant to be robbed, but since you are now trained in the first hospital, we will not just watch our talents be poached by others."
Having said this, he took out a document from the drawer and pushed it in front of Su ye.
"This is the hospital's intention to stay agreement for you."
Su ye lowered his head and glanced.
Written in black and white on the letterhead, it clearly says "Agreement of Intention for Young Talents to Stay in Jiangcheng First People's Hospital."
Vice President Zhao continued: "The meaning is very simple. You sign it first. After the training is over, as long as there are no major mistakes or problems of principle, the hospital will definitely give priority to hiring you. I will greet you in advance from the HR side and the department side."
"In addition, as long as you continue to maintain your current performance, we will give you higher skill scores and rotation assessments. As for the training time..." Vice President Zhao paused, with a meaningful smile on his lips, "We will reduce it as appropriate."
Su ye raised his head.
The prescribed training time is in principle fixed and cannot be changed easily, but since Vice President Zhao dares to say it, it means that the hospital is ready to give him the green light.
Vice President Zhao looked at Su Ye and his tone was very calm but very serious.
